title: Injectivity of restriction for ideal-power-torsion-free sections
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], I a finite-type quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], and i:I -> O_X a monomorphism. Form recursive ideal powers P_n with inclusions j_n [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk]. Let F be quasi-coherent and U open with x in U exactly when the stalk map i_x is surjective. Assume for every n and W that a section z of F(W) is zero whenever j_n(b)*z|V=0 for every V <= W and b in P_n(V). Then for every open W the restriction F(W) -> F(W intersect U) is injective. No compactness or quasi-separatedness is required.

source.place: Tag 01PM, localization and injectivity argument; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PM, specialized to vanishing ideal-power annihilators.

proof.text: Subtract sections with equal restriction, and cover W by all affine subopens A. For f in the section image J of I, its germ is an invertible element of the ideal stalk on D(f), hence D(f) lies in U. The restricted difference z vanishes there. The affine localization theorem yields a power of every f in J killing z.

Finite type makes Gamma(A,I) finite and hence its image J finitely generated. Put L=ker(a maps to a*z). The preceding localization equations imply J <= radical(L). Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg gives d with J^d <= L. The proved powers_affine_sections helper identifies the recursive inclusion image on A with J^d. Thus every power section on A kills z.

For b on D(g), use the affine localization denominator formula for the quasi-coherent power module to express g^k*b as the restriction of a section t on A. Naturality of the inclusion and scalar action identifies its product with z as the restriction of j_d(t)*z=0. The restriction of g is a unit, so cancel g^k. Cover every V inside A by basic opens and apply sheaf separation: all local power sections annihilate z|V. The given htf yields z=0 on A. Finally separate on the affine cover of W. This works for empty covers, J=0, J=top, and d=0.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01PM, affine localization argument, written out for section restriction and the local htf formulation.

lean.statement:
theorem ideal_power_torsionFree_section_restriction
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : X.Modules}
    (ι : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) [Mono ι]
    [I.IsQuasicoherent] [I.IsFiniteType]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U ↔ Function.Surjective
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map ι).hom)
    (htf : ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : X.Opens) (x : F.val.obj (op W)),
      (∀ (V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ W)
        (b : (idealSheafPower ι n).1.val.obj (op V)),
        ((idealSheafPower ι n).2.val.app (op V) b : Γ(X, V)) •
          F.val.map (homOfLE h).op x = 0) → x = 0)
    (W : X.Opens) :
    Function.Injective (F.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U ≤ W)).op)
